description: Defines the URLSecurityManager class and related allowlist class for managing URL security policies, including default credentials and Kerberos delegation, within the Chromium project.

classes.name: URLSecurityManager
classes.description: Abstract class managing URL security policies, including allowlists for credentials and Kerberos delegation.

classes.name: URLSecurityManagerAllowlist
classes.description: Concrete implementation of URLSecurityManager that uses allowlists for security policies.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a platform-dependent instance of URLSecurityManager.

methods.name: CanUseDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Checks if default credentials can be used for a given URL.

methods.name: CanDelegate
methods.description: Checks if Kerberos delegation is allowed for a given URL.

methods.name: SetDefaultAllowlist
methods.description: Sets the default allowlist for credentials.

methods.name: SetDelegateAllowlist
methods.description: Sets the delegate allowlist for Kerberos tickets.

methods.name: URLSecurityManagerAllowlist
methods.description: Implements URLSecurityManager with allowlists for security policies.

methods.name: HasDefaultAllowlist
methods.description: Checks if a default allowlist is set.
